results.remarks: Welcome to this beautiful 2023-built home offering 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and 2,617 square feet of living space on a large 9,933 sq. ft. lot in Victorville! With a modern layout and a unique floor plan, this home is perfect for growing families, multi-generational living, or anyone looking for extra space. As you walk through the front door, you're welcomed by an open floor plan with durable vinyl flooring, shutters, and plenty of natural light. The kitchen overlooks the main living area, making it the heart of the home. It features white cabinetry, granite countertops, a large island with seating, stainless steel appliances, and plenty of cabinet space for storage. One of the best features of this home is the private in-law quarters located inside the home with its own separate entrance. This space includes a living area, a full bedroom, full bathroom, laundry hookups, a microwave, and room for a small refrigerator. Whether it's for extended family, guests, a college student, or even a private office setup, this space offers so many possibilities. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious loft that can be used as a second family room, game room, or home office. There are three additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and an upstairs laundry room for added convenience. The primary suite is generously sized and features a private bathroom with dual sinks, a walk-in shower, and a large walk-in closet. Step outside to a backyard that's ready for your personal touch. With block wall fencing already in place and some concrete completed, there's still plenty of room to design the backyard you've always wanted, whether that's a pool, outdoor kitchen, garden, or entertainment space. Additional features include a 2-car garage and solar panels to help with energy efficiency. Conveniently located near schools, Highway 395, the I-15 freeway, shopping centers, restaurants, and other everyday amenities, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, flexibility, and location. If you've been looking for a newer home with room for everyone, this one is definitely worth seeing!

results.remarks: Welcome to your oasis in the prestigious, master-planned community of Spring Valley Lake! This beautiful single-story home offers 1,882 square feet of meticulously maintained living space, perfectly blending modern comfort with a resort-style lifestyle. The home features 4 spacious bedrooms, 2 pristine bathrooms, a comfortable living room equipped with surround sound, and a cozy fireplace in the dining room—perfect for gathering and entertaining. The highly desirable 3-car garage provides ample room for vehicles, a workshop, or lake toys, and offers excellent functionality with a newly replaced 2-car garage door, plus brand-new springs, cables, and mechanical components completely refreshed on both the 2-car and single garage doors. Additional major high-ticket upgrades offer ultimate peace of mind, including a brand-new central AC unit and a brand-new water heater for year-round energy efficiency. Step outside into your private backyard oasis, fully enclosed by clean, low-maintenance vinyl fencing. This peaceful outdoor space is beautifully landscaped with a lush blend of green grass, vibrant bushes, and established trees. The home’s charming curb appeal is accented by a clean, low-maintenance front yard featuring neat rock scaping, while the property also includes two large storage sheds for all your extra hobbies and storage needs. Living here means enjoying the unmatched, private amenities of Spring Valley Lake, where every day feels like a vacation. Residents enjoy access to a 200-acre waterski lake with a full-service marina, boat launch, and fuel station, alongside a private sandy beach, a community swim area, a splash zone, picnic areas, and beach volleyball. The community also boasts multiple parks, a dedicated dog park, 14 designated fishing areas, an equestrian center, and 24/7 public safety patrols. For golf and fitness enthusiasts, the award-winning Bear Valley Country Club is right in the neighborhood, offering separate memberships for an 18-hole course, tennis, pickleball, a pool, a sauna, and dining. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a beautifully upgraded home in the Victor Valley's premier location.
